_meta.note: Pure-Python port of the HeartBeat substrate (zero node/bash for OUR tooling). Lives in py/ as a pip-installable package `heartbeat` with console script `hb`. Core is stdlib-only; agno/crewai are optional extras. Gate cmds remain user-authored shell (the DAG contract). Verified by pytest (py/tests) — the real gate.

tasks.title: Author the state tests
tasks.description: Write py/tests/test_state.py asserting the event-sourced projection: initialized/task_started/task_done/task_failed/lease_expired/gate_passed/gate_failed/review_passed/review_failed derive completed_tasks, active_tasks, completed_phases, pending_reviews, build_stuck_count, current_phase — matching the node projector semantics.

tasks.title: Package layout + pyproject
tasks.description: Create py/pyproject.toml (stdlib-only core, console script hb=heartbeat.cli:main, optional extras agno/crewai) and py/src/heartbeat/__init__.py.

tasks.title: state.py + protocol.py
tasks.description: Implement py/src/heartbeat/state.py (read/append events.jsonl, project(events,dag)->state, atomic write, write-lock, leases helpers) and py/src/heartbeat/protocol.py (the reason->action PROTOCOL map + render_md).

tasks.title: Author resolver + lint tests
tasks.description: Write py/tests/test_resolver.py and py/tests/test_lint.py: gate-aware resolve() (next_task/gate_pending/review_pending/all_done/deadlock/busy), ready_tasks(), and lint (duplicate ids, broken requires, cycles, undefined gates, oversized phases).

tasks.title: resolver.py + lint.py
tasks.description: Implement py/src/heartbeat/resolver.py (resolve, ready_tasks) and py/src/heartbeat/lint.py (lint, extract_paths) porting the node semantics faithfully.

tasks.title: Author gate + tick tests
tasks.description: Write py/tests/test_gate.py and py/tests/test_tick.py: gate runs criteria via the system shell with a timeout, appends gate_passed/failed, advances the phase; tick does the Stage-A priority checks (lock, integrity, lease reclaim, circuit breaker, gate errors, next task) and returns {wakeAgent,data}.

tasks.title: gate.py + tick.py
tasks.description: Implement py/src/heartbeat/gate.py (eval criteria, --check/--all, optional git snapshot) and py/src/heartbeat/tick.py (Stage A) porting tick.sh/gate.sh semantics; gate cmds run via subprocess shell.

tasks.title: Author CLI tests
tasks.description: Write py/tests/test_cli.py driving the hb console end-to-end: init a project, lint, tick, start/done, gate, report, doctor, diagnose, protocol.

tasks.title: cli.py + scaffold.py + report.py + doctor/diagnose
tasks.description: Implement py/src/heartbeat/cli.py (argparse subcommands), scaffold.py (hb init writes .hb/ dag/state/events/executor.json), report.py, and doctor()+diagnose() computed root-cause.

tasks.title: Author executor tests
tasks.description: Write py/tests/test_exec.py: the driver drives a stub-backed project to all_done, escalate-only on gate_blocked, per-task attempt cap, strict-gate refusal, and worktree-isolated parallel fan-out.

tasks.title: executor.py + backends
tasks.description: Implement py/src/heartbeat/executor.py (serial + parallel worktree, heartbeat pump, escalate-only, attempt cap, strict) and py/src/heartbeat/backends/ (ollama, agno, crewai, script, claude) with an in-process execute/refute contract and shared _fileblocks.

tasks.title: Author install + live tests
tasks.description: Write py/tests/test_smoke.py (pip install into a venv, hb --help, hb init+tick works) and py/real-backend.py (live end-to-end with the ollama backend).

tasks.title: Finalize packaging + docs
tasks.description: Finalize py/pyproject.toml extras and console_scripts, write py/README.md documenting the pure-Python port and zero node/bash, and run the live ollama end-to-end.

criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR/py" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import heartbeat, heartbeat.state, heartbeat.protocol"

GATE_PP1.desc: Resolver and lint match node semantics.

criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR/py" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_resolver.py tests/test_lint.py

GATE_PP2.desc: Gate runner and tick drive a project.

review.prompt: Refute that PP2 is done: does the Python tick REALLY reproduce tick.sh's priority order and lease/stale semantics, or did it skip a check? Does the gate append the right events and advance the phase only on a genuine pass? Are the tests hollow (asserting mocks instead of real subprocess gate runs)?

criteria.cmd: cd "$PROJECT_DIR/py" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_gate.py tests/test_tick.py

GATE_PP4.desc: Executor drives backends, serial and parallel.
